text.content: ki Grammar 9 Simple present vs. present continuous
Use the simple present to describe routines and permanent situations. Verbs not usually used
Kenji works on Saturdays. in continuous tenses
Jan studies every night. believe mean
Use the present continuous to describe actions in progress
Amelia is going to class right now.
Jan is preparing for her medical school entrance exams. like understand
Amelia and Ricardo are taking an English class together. love want
